image_description: A low-angle, wide-lens shot of a concrete outdoor staircase with a modern metal handrail system. The handrail consists of two parallel tubular steel bars supported by curved vertical posts attached to the side of the stairs. In the background, there is a tall white building against a deep blue sky, and three people are sitting on the upper steps.
